entities.name: Balatonfenyves Narrow Gauge Railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Balatonfenyves narrow-gauge railway runs from Balatonfenyves on the South shore of Lake Balaton to Somogyszentpál over a distance of 13 km. It is the last remaining MÁV-operated narrow-gauge railroad of Hungary as of 2017.
